summary: Iter17 tests: 4 backend features (combo-hints, substitutes, delivery ingest/simulate/inbox, preauth) all pass — 7/7 pytest. 4 frontend flows tested: Preauth modal → /register redirect PASS; Delivery simulate 2x PASS (rose/emerald/amber cards); Combo Heat-Map glow PASS but badge text is broken; Substitution Pop on Register FAIL — 86'd product tile is disabled at ProductGrid so click never reaches addProduct().

ui_bugs.issue: Renders '-undefined%' for percent combos. Frontend uses hint.discount_value but backend /api/floorplan/combo-hints returns {discount, discount_type, ...} with NO discount_value key.

Button is `disabled={eight}` and onClick guarded by `!eight && onPick(p)` — so tapping a 86'd tile never fires the substitution toast. Register.jsx addProduct() has correct substitute-fetch code but it is unreachable.

integration_issues.issue: End-to-end broken: /menu 86 toggle works, GET /products/{id}/substitutes returns valid subs (verified in backend tests), but Register UI cannot invoke it because the tile is disabled. Remove `disabled={eight}` and `!eight &&` guard in ProductGrid.jsx (still keep visual 86'd overlay).

frontend.delivery_simulate_x2: PASS — 2 new delivery-card-* rendered (rose/emerald/amber platform tint verified visually)
frontend.combo_heat_map_glow: PARTIAL — cyan glow + combo-hint-<TableName> badge renders, but text is '+1 Johnnie → -undefined%' instead of '+1 Johnnie → -10%'
frontend.substitution_pop: FAIL — click on 86'd Hong Kong Sour tile does nothing (tile disabled); no toast fires

action_items: FIX Floorplan.jsx line 331: replace `${hint.discount_value}%` with reading the combo's percent value. Cleanest fix: backend routers/orders.py combo_hints() should also emit `discount_value: c.get('discount_value')` in each hint dict. Then the current frontend code renders correctly.

FIX ProductGrid.jsx: remove `disabled={eight}` and change onClick to `() => onPick(p)` so 86'd tiles still fire addProduct(); keep the visual 86'd overlay. Register.jsx already handles the p.eightysix branch and shows the substitute toast.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/orders.py combo_hints returns `discount` (money) + `discount_type` but not `discount_value` — mismatched contract with Floorplan.jsx expectation.
ProductGrid.jsx blocks 86'd clicks entirely, defeating the whole Substitution Pop feature.

success_rate.frontend: 50% (2/4 flows fully green; combo badge text bug + substitution pop unreachable)

seed_data_creation: None — all test artifacts (orders, 86 toggles) cleaned up after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Two focused frontend fixes needed: (a) include discount_value in combo_hints response, (b) unblock click on 86'd product tile in ProductGrid.jsx. After fixes, re-run only the two failing frontend flows.
rca of the issue: 1) Combo badge: contract mismatch between backend `/api/floorplan/combo-hints` (returns discount, discount_type) and frontend Floorplan.jsx line 331 (reads hint.discount_value). Reproduction: open dine-in order with 1x Hong Kong Sour on any table → Floorplan renders `+1 Johnnie → -undefined%`. 2) Substitution Pop: ProductGrid.jsx renders 86'd tiles with `disabled={eight}` AND guards onClick with `!eight && onPick(p)`. Since HTML disabled buttons don't fire click events, Register.jsx addProduct() never runs and cannot dispatch the substitute toast even though GET /api/products/{id}/substitutes works correctly (verified by backend pytest).
